components.name: Logo
components.purpose: Display FidNext Technologies brand identity.

responsive.mobile: Use compact or appropriately scaled version.

requirements: If clickable, expose the destination through an accessible link.

usageRules: Use the approved FidNext logo asset.
Do not distort or recolor without approval.

components.name: PrimaryButton
components.purpose: Primary conversion action.

responsive.mobile: Maintain touch-friendly target and adapt width when necessary.

requirements: Use a semantic button or link.
Do not communicate state through color alone.
Loading state must prevent duplicate submission where applicable.

usageRules: Use for the highest-priority action.
Primary homepage conversion is Book a Free Consultation.

components.name: SecondaryButton
components.purpose: Secondary navigation or exploration action.

responsive.mobile: Stack or expand where required by layout.
responsive.desktop: Use alongside primary actions when appropriate.

requirements: Use semantic link or button based on behavior.

usageRules: Use for lower-priority actions such as View Our Work.

components.name: TextButton
components.purpose: Low-emphasis action.
usageRules: Do not use when the action requires primary visual emphasis.

components.name: IconButton
components.purpose: Compact interactive control.

responsive.mobile: Maintain touch target of at least 44px.

requirements: Do not rely on icon shape alone.

usageRules: Use for mobile menu, close, and utility controls.

components.name: TextLink
components.purpose: Inline or contextual navigation.

responsive.mobile: Preserve readable text and touch usability.

usageRules: Link text should communicate destination clearly.

components.name: Header
components.purpose: Global site navigation and primary conversion access.

responsive.tablet: Adapt navigation according to available space.
responsive.desktop: Display full navigation and primary CTA.

requirements: Use semantic header and nav elements.
Mobile menu must be keyboard accessible.

usageRules: Primary CTA should remain visually prominent.

components.name: Navigation
components.purpose: Provide access to primary site sections.
usageRules: Core navigation includes Services, How We Work, Technology, About, and Contact.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Provide secondary navigation, contact context, and conversion support.
usageRules: Do not invent contact details or claims.

components.name: Hero
components.purpose: Communicate positioning, value proposition, and primary conversion action.

responsive.mobile: Single-column priority order with CTA prominence.
responsive.tablet: Reduce horizontal complexity while preserving hierarchy.

requirements: Provide meaningful alternative text for media.

usageRules: Primary heading direction: Build Better Technology. Move Your Business Forward.
Primary CTA: Book a Free Consultation.
Do not add unverified proof metrics.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.purpose: Establish section hierarchy.

requirements: Do not skip heading levels for styling.

usageRules: Use consistently across major sections.

components.name: BaseCard
components.purpose: Reusable container for structured content.

responsive.mobile: Stack content and maintain readable padding.

requirements: Do not make a non-interactive card appear interactive.

usageRules: Avoid excessive card usage.
Do not use cards merely for decoration.

components.name: ServiceBlock
components.purpose: Present FidNext service capabilities.

requirements: Interactive actions must be keyboard accessible.

usageRules: Confirmed services: Software Consulting and Custom Software Development.
Proposed services must be validation-gated.
Do not present unvalidated capabilities as confirmed facts.

components.name: ProblemBlock
components.purpose: Present customer problems and pain points.

requirements: Do not rely on decorative icons to convey meaning.

usageRules: Focus on business problems and clarity.
Avoid unnecessary technical jargon.

components.name: ProcessStep
components.purpose: Communicate FidNext delivery and Agile process.

responsive.desktop: Use horizontal or structured grid layout.

requirements: Process order must remain understandable without visual styling.

usageRules: Approved themes include Iterative Development, Cross-Functional Teams, Customer Collaboration, and Continuous Improvement.

components.name: TechnologyItem
components.purpose: Present confirmed technology expertise.

responsive.mobile: Use compact responsive grid or list.

requirements: Technology names must be readable as text.
Icons must not be the sole source of information.

usageRules: Confirmed references include Web Development, Android, iOS, Cloud Applications, Java, React Native, and Python.
Do not imply unsupported expertise.

components.name: CaseStudyCard
components.purpose: Present verified project or case-study information.

requirements: Interactive case studies require keyboard access.

usageRules: Use verified information only.
Do not invent client names, logos, metrics, outcomes, dates, or project values.
Use REQUIRES_INPUT when evidence is unavailable.

components.name: Testimonial
components.purpose: Present approved client or stakeholder testimonial.
usageRules: Only approved real testimonials may be used.
Never fabricate testimonials.

components.name: ConsultationForm
components.purpose: Capture qualified consultation leads.

responsive.desktop: Structured form layout with clear hierarchy.

requirements: Every field requires an accessible label.
Errors must be associated with fields.

usageRules: Primary conversion action is Book a Free Consultation.
Do not request unnecessary information.

components.name: TextInput
components.purpose: Capture short text input.
usageRules: Avoid placeholder-only labeling.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: Capture longer business or project context.
usageRules: Use for project/business context or optional message.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: Allow selection from predefined options.

requirements: Use native or fully accessible select behavior.

usageRules: Use only where predefined choices improve the form experience.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: Capture optional boolean or multi-select choices.
usageRules: Use only when the information is necessary.

components.name: Radio
components.purpose: Capture one selection from a mutually exclusive group.
usageRules: Use only when mutually exclusive choices are necessary.

components.name: Accordion
components.purpose: Reveal secondary information without overwhelming the page.

requirements: Expanded state must be programmatically exposed.

usageRules: Recommended for FAQs and secondary explanatory content.
Do not hide critical primary content inside accordions.

components.name: Modal
components.purpose: Present focused secondary interactions or confirmations.

responsive.mobile: Use full-width or near-full-screen treatment when appropriate.

usageRules: Use sparingly.
Do not place core discoverable website content inside unnecessary modals.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.purpose: Provide orientation on deeper pages.

responsive.mobile: Simplify or truncate while preserving orientation.

usageRules: Do not display on homepage.
Use on deeper pages when beneficial.

components.name: FinalCTA
components.purpose: Provide a strong closing conversion opportunity.

responsive.mobile: Stack content and prioritize primary CTA.

usageRules: Primary action should normally be Book a Free Consultation.

components.name: Image
components.purpose: Provide controlled imagery within the design system.

responsive.mobile: Maintain appropriate aspect ratio and avoid overflow.

requirements: Meaningful images require descriptive alt text.
Decorative images should not add redundant accessible content.

usageRules: Avoid unapproved stock photography.
Use imagery only where it supports business communication.

general: Prefer reusable components over page-specific duplicates.
Use design tokens instead of arbitrary visual values.
Preserve approved UX and content hierarchy.
Do not invent unverified business claims.
validation: Brand colors require validation before final implementation.
Typography requires validation before final implementation.
Icon library requires validation before final implementation.
Case studies and testimonials require verified source material.

requirements: Use component IDs as stable implementation references.
Do not invent unresolved brand values.
